description: This file defines the class AzureQueueBatchContainerV2, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for Azure Queue storage streaming in Orleans. It manages batching of stream events with support for external serializers, holds event sequences, and manages request context data.

classes.name: AzureQueueBatchContainerV2
classes.description: A serializable batch container for Azure Queue streaming, supporting external serializers and managing stream events with sequence tokens.

methods.name: AzureQueueBatchContainerV2
methods.description: Constructor initializing the batch container with stream ID, events, request context, and sequence token.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Returns the contained events cast to a specific type, each associated with a sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the stored request context into the current execution context.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the batch container.
